wings.d: A cosmic shroud of living tendrils around a black-hole core. Its tips glow like distant stars. Needs level 70. Gives a double jump.
Radiant white feathers in three tiers around a glowing halo ring, shedding petals of light. Needs level 60. Gives a double jump.
Wings of raw blue lightning: three tiers of crackling energy that arc and spit sparks. Needs level 55. Gives a double jump.
Skeletal wings of curved bone; pale light drips from every joint like a melting dawn. Needs level 50. Gives a double jump.
Translucent violet feathers that glow from within, crowned by curved talons at the wrist. Needs level 48. Gives a double jump.
Black armoured wing plates joined by violet glowing seams, layered in three hinged tiers. Needs level 45. Gives a double jump.
Vast dusky moth wings painted with watchful glowing eyes; they scatter luminous scales. Needs level 42. Gives a double jump.
Brush-stroke wings of black ink that dissolve into drifting wisps, streaked with pale light. Needs level 40. Gives a double jump.
